choose.when: ORDER BY r.created_at ASC, r.id ASC
ORDER BY p.starts_at ASC, r.id ASC
ORDER BY p.starts_at DESC, r.id DESC
choose.otherwise: ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC

mapper.select:
SELECT r.id AS reservationId, r.reservation_number AS reservationNumber, r.status AS reservationStatus,
m.id AS memberId, m.email AS memberEmail, m.name AS memberName,
c.id AS concertId, c.title AS concertTitle, c.poster_url AS posterUrl,
p.id AS performanceId, p.starts_at AS startsAt, p.ends_at AS endsAt,
v.id AS venueId, v.name AS venueName,
vh.id AS venueHallId, vh.name AS venueHallName,
( SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM v1_reservation_seats rs
WHERE rs.reservation_id = r.id ) AS ticketCount,
r.total_amount AS totalAmount,
pay.id AS paymentId, pay.payment_number AS paymentNumber, pay.provider AS paymentProvider, pay.method AS paymentMethod, pay.status AS paymentStatus, pay.approved_at AS paymentApprovedAt,
r.expires_at AS expiresAt, r.completed_at AS completedAt, r.cancelled_at AS cancelledAt, r.created_at AS reservedAt
FROM v1_reservations r
INNER JOIN v1_members m ON m.id = r.member_id
INNER JOIN v1_performances p ON p.id = r.performance_id
INNER JOIN v1_concerts c ON c.id = p.concert_id
INNER JOIN v1_venue_halls vh ON vh.id = p.venue_hall_id
INNER JOIN v1_venues v ON v.id = vh.venue_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ranked.id, ranked.payment_number, ranked.reservation_id, ranked.provider, ranked.method, ranked.status, ranked.approved_at
FROM ( SELECT p2.id, p2.payment_number, p2.reservation_id, p2.provider, p2.method, p2.status, p2.approved_at,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p2.reservation_id ORDER BY p2.created_at DESC, p2.id DESC ) AS rn
FROM v1_payments p2
) ranked
WHERE ranked.rn = 1
) pay ON pay.reservation_id = r.id
LIMIT #{condition.size} OFFSET #{condition.offset}

FROM v1_reservations r
INNER JOIN v1_members m ON m.id = r.member_id
INNER JOIN v1_performances p ON p.id = r.performance_id
INNER JOIN v1_concerts c ON c.id = p.concert_id
